title: Nepal’s trade routes to China suffer repeated monsoon disruptions - The Kathmandu Post
description: Nepal’s trade routes to China suffer repeated monsoon disruptions  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Every monsoon, Nepal’s northern trade routes are disrupted by landslides and floods, blocking roads, washing away bridges and bringing cargo movement with China to a near halt.

The problem has persisted for nearly a decade, and this year is no different. The disruption comes just as Nepal enters its peak festival season, leaving traders and consumers to bear the rising costs.

The problem is partly geographic. Nepal’s two main overland routes to China run through steep, unstable terrain along fast-flowing rivers. Narendra Pariyar, chief district officer of Rasuwa, describes landslides as “frequent” and the road as one that “goes on and off during monsoon”.

But experts say the recurring disruptions are not simply a product of Nepal’s difficult terrain. They also reflect years of inadequate planning and investment.

“Engineers only design the road, ignoring the geography connected to the road,” said Kalpana Adhikari, general secretary of the Nepal Geotechnical Society. Slope investigations and protection measures are often overlooked during road construction.

The current government’s decision to allocate separate budgets for slope studies and protection is a positive development, she said.

Trade officials and business leaders estimate that stabilising the worst landslide-prone section could cost around Rs200 million. Yet even projects that have been contracted have failed to materialise.

A Rs480 million contract to repair a vulnerable section was cancelled after China offered to undertake the work itself. Years later, neither side has acted, leaving the section unfinished.

Tatopani, which has operated since 1967 at the end of the Araniko Highway, is now completely closed because of landslides along the Tatopani-Bahrabise section.

The closure is hardly an isolated event. For the past eight to 10 years, the road has been hit by landslides of varying severity almost every monsoon, cutting off the border for weeks or months.

Krishna Prasad Sharma, assistant chief district officer in Sindhupalchok, said the geography makes the road particularly vulnerable. The highway runs along a steep slope, with the Bhotekoshi river cutting directly below it.

The crossing’s problems date back even further. The 2015 earthquake devastated the area, and the route has never fully recovered. Exports to China through Tatopani have not resumed since the earthquake because China has not reopened the crossing to outbound cargo.

In normal times, the point handles 30 to 40 trucks a day. Officials had hoped to generate Rs25 billion in annual revenue from the crossing. That target is now out of reach with the border closed at the beginning of the fiscal year.

Traders have instead been forced to route goods through Kerung, on the Chinese side of the border. The detour has more than tripled the cost of transporting a consignment to Kathmandu, from around Rs90,000 to about Rs300,000, while also lengthening delivery times.

“Summer goods can end up arriving in winter”, said Rajendra Sangraula, president of the Nepal Freight Forwarders Association. Delays also mean higher detention charges for containers stranded on the route.

Rasuwagadhi faces a similar problem, although its immediate trigger is different.

The Syabrubesi-Rasuwagadhi road, opened by the Nepali Army in 2018, was supposed to be upgraded under a 2019 Nepal-China implementation agreement using Chinese grant assistance. The work remains incomplete.

The 16-km stretch continues to flood and wash out during the monsoon. Last July, a flash flood on the Lhende river swept away the Miteri Bridge connecting Nepal and China and severely damaged the customs yard.

A Bailey bridge has since replaced the original crossing, but its capacity is roughly half that of the old bridge. Daily cargo movement has fallen from 60 to 70 loaded containers to around 30 to 40.

The Integrated Check Post at Rasuwagadhi is also unfinished. According to Pariyar, construction is only around 60 percent complete. Customs operations on the Nepali side continue from a makeshift facility.

Kewal Prasad Bhandari, former secretary of the National Planning Commission and former chief of the Tatopani Customs, said the lack of proper facilities is another constraint on northern trade. “Rasuwagadhi still lacks smooth customs infrastructure”, he said.

Korala, a newer crossing that opened for international trade last fiscal year, has provided another route but handles only limited cargo and remains far less significant than Tatopani and Rasuwagadhi.

The consequences of the disruptions are being felt beyond the border districts.

Rerouting goods through Kerung alone adds an estimated 20 to 25 percent to their cost by the time they reach consumers. Freight operators expect overall logistical costs to rise to around 30 percent this year, from 22 percent last year.

The additional cost comes at a particularly difficult time, as consumers prepare for Teej, Dashain and Tihar and the demand for imported goods increases.

The disruption also exposes a much larger imbalance in Nepal-China trade. Tatopani and Rasuwagadhi together handled more than Rs93 billion in imports last fiscal year. Exports to China, meanwhile, remained below Rs2 billion, according to trade data.

Poor road connectivity is part of the problem. But traders and experts say Nepal’s weak export infrastructure is an equally important constraint.

Nepal lacks functioning laboratory testing and quarantine facilities needed to meet Chinese phytosanitary requirements. Its national trade strategy also focuses its priority export products largely on the Indian market rather than China.

“The underlying issue is diplomatic as much as physical,” said Posh Raj Pandey, chair emeritus of the South Asia Watch on Trade, Economics and Environment. “Diplomatic negotiation needs to be done for the trade route that is cost efficient.”

According to Pandey, Nepal’s trade diplomacy has historically focused more heavily on India, leaving the northern route under-prioritised in infrastructure and export planning. He also pointed to what he sees as an inconsistency in dealing with non-tariff barriers: restrictions affecting exports to India attract immediate political attention, while similar barriers facing Nepali goods entering China receive far less scrutiny.

Trade experts say the infrastructure problems reflect a broader weakness in Nepal-China trade relations.

Rabi Shankar Sainju, a trade expert, said the two countries’ basic trade framework has failed to keep pace with changing economic realities.

“The Trade and Payments Agreement is outdated and this needs to be reviewed as we stand at a completely different trade era now,” he said.

The 2018 transit agreement gave Nepal access, in principle, to Chinese seaports and dry ports. But the two countries have yet to finalise the standard operating procedures needed to make the arrangement fully functional.

A provision requiring the agreement to be reviewed every two years has also seen little meaningful implementation, with the mechanism meeting only once or twice, largely ceremonially, according to Sainju.

नेपाल भू-तकनीकी सोसाइटीके महासचिव कल्पना अधिकारी कहलनि जे, अभियंता सब सड़क स जुड़ल भूगोल के अनदेखी करैत केवल सड़क के डिजाइन करैत छथि। सड़क निर्माण कें दौरान ढलान कें जांच आ सुरक्षा उपायक कें अक्सर अनदेखी कैल जायत छै.

ओ कहली जे वर्तमान सरकार क ढलान क अध्ययन आ सुरक्षा लेल अलग-अलग बजट आवंटित करबाक फैसला सकारात्मक विकास अछि।

व्यापार अधिकारी आरू व्यापारिक नेता सिनी के अनुमान छै कि सबसें खराब भूस्खलन वाला हिस्सा क स्थिर करै मँ लगभग 20 करोड़ रुपया के खर्च आबै सकै छै । तइयो जे परियोजना ठेका पर भेटल अछि ओ तक साकार नहि भ सकल अछि।

चीन न॑ खुद ई काम करै के प्रस्ताव देला के बाद एगो कमजोर खंड के मरम्मत के 48 करोड़ रुपया के ठेका रद्द करी देलऽ गेलै । सालों बाद दुनू पक्ष कोनो कार्रवाई नहि केलक अछि, जाहि स इ खंड अधूरा भ गेल अछि।

1967 स॑ अरनिको राजमार्ग केरऽ अंत म॑ चलै वाला ताटोपानी अब॑ ततोपानी-बहराबीसे खंड के साथ भूस्खलन के वजह स॑ पूरा तरह स॑ बंद छै ।

सिन्धुपाल्चोक के सहायक मुख्य जिला अधिकारी कृष्णप्रसाद शर्मा कहलनि जे, भूगोल सड़क के विशेष रूप सं कमजोर बना दैत अछि। ई राजमार्ग एकटा खड़ा ढलान पर चलैत अछि, जकर सीधा नीचा भोटेकोशी नदी कटैत अछि ।

क्रॉसिंग’क समस्या आओर पहिने के अछि. 2015 केरऽ भूकंप न॑ ई इलाका क॑ तबाह करी देलकै, आरू ई मार्ग कहियो पूरा तरह स॑ ठीक नै होय सकलऽ छै । भूकंप के बाद ततोपानी के माध्यम सं चीन के निर्यात फेर सं शुरू नहिं भेल अछि किएक त चीन एहि क्रासिंग के आउटबाउंड कार्गो के लेल फेर सं नहिं खोललक अछि.

16 किलोमीटर के ई हिस्सा मानसून के दौरान बाढ़ आ बहैत रहैत अछि. पिछला जुलाई मे ल्हेंडे नदी पर आयल झटका बाढ़ि नेपाल आ चीन कए जोड़य वाला मितेरी पुल कए बहरा गेल आ कस्टम यार्ड कए काफी नुकसान पहुंचेलक।

एकरऽ बाद मूल क्रॉसिंग के जगह बेली पुल बनी गेलऽ छै, लेकिन एकरऽ क्षमता पुरानऽ पुल के तुलना म॑ लगभग आधा छै । रोजाना माल केरऽ आवाजाही 60 स॑ घटी क॑ 70 लोडेड कंटेनर होय गेलऽ छै आरू लगभग 30 स॑ 40 होय गेलऽ छै ।

राष्ट्रीय योजना आयोग के पूर्व सचिव आ ताटोपनी सीमा शुल्क के पूर्व प्रमुख केवल प्रसाद भण्डारी उत्तर व्यापार पर उचित सुविधा के अभाव एकटा आओर बाधा बतौलनि। ओ कहला जे रसुवागढ़ी मे एखनो सुचारू सीमा शुल्क क बुनियादी ढांचा क अभाव अछि।

पिछला वित्तीय वर्ष अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार लेली खुललऽ नया क्रासिंग कोरला न॑ एगो आरू मार्ग उपलब्ध कराय देल॑ छै लेकिन सीमित माल ही संभाल॑ छै आरू ततोपानी आरू रसुवागाढ़ी स॑ कहीं कम महत्वपूर्ण बनलऽ छै ।

सीमावर्ती जिला स बाहर एहि व्यवधान क परिणाम महसूस भ रहल अछि।

असगर केरुंग के माध्यम सं सामान के फेर सं रूट करय सं उपभोक्ता तक पहुंचय तक ओकर लागत में अनुमानित 20 सं 25 प्रतिशत के बढ़ोतरी भ जायत अछि. माल ढुलाई संचालक कए उम्मीद अछि जे एहि साल समग्र रसद लागत बढ़ि कए करीब 30 प्रतिशत भ जाएत, जे पिछला साल 22 प्रतिशत छल।

अतिरिक्त लागत विशेष रूप स कठिन समय मे आबि रहल अछि, किया कि उपभोक्ता तीज, दशैन आ तिहार क तैयारी करैत छथि आ आयातित सामान क मांग बढ़ैत अछि।

एहि व्यवधान स नेपाल-चीन व्यापार मे बहुत पैघ असंतुलन सेहो उजागर भ रहल अछि। तातोपानी आ रसुवागढ़ी मिल कए पिछला वित्तीय वर्ष मे 93 अरब टका स बेसी क आयात केलक अछि। ओतहि चीन मे निर्यात 2 अरब टका स कम रहल, व्यापारिक आंकड़ा क अनुसार।

सड़क क खराब संपर्क एहि समस्या क हिस्सा अछि। मुदा व्यापारी आ विशेषज्ञ के कहनाय छनि जे नेपाल के कमजोर निर्यात बुनियादी ढांचा सेहो ओतबे महत्वपूर्ण बाधा अछि.

नेपालमे चीनी पादप स्वच्छता आवश्यकताक पूर्तिक लेल आवश्यक प्रयोगशाला परीक्षण आ क्वारेन्टाइन सुविधाक कार्यरत अभाव अछि । एकरऽ राष्ट्रीय व्यापार रणनीति भी अपनऽ प्राथमिकता वाला निर्यात उत्पाद क॑ चीन के बजाय भारतीय बाजार प॑ काफी हद तलक केंद्रित करै छै ।

साउथ एशिया वॉच ऑन ट्रेड, इकोनॉमिक्स एंड एनवायरनमेंट केरऽ चेयर एमेरिटस पॉश राज पांडेय न॑ कहलकै कि अंतर्निहित मुद्दा कूटनीतिक भी छै जेतना कि भौतिक छै । “व्यापार मार्ग लेली कूटनीतिक वार्ता करै के जरूरत छै जे लागत कुशल होय।”

पाण्डेय के अनुसार नेपाल के व्यापार कूटनीति ऐतिहासिक रूप स॑ भारत प॑ अधिक केन्द्रित रहलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ पूर्वाधार आरू निर्यात योजना म॑ उत्तरी मार्ग क॑ कम प्राथमिकता देलऽ गेलऽ छै । हुनी गैर-शुल्क बाधा स॑ निपटै म॑ जेकरा क॑ असंगति के रूप म॑ देखै छै, ओकरा प॑ भी इशारा करलकै : भारत म॑ निर्यात क॑ प्रभावित करै वाला प्रतिबंध तत्काल राजनीतिक ध्यान आकर्षित करै छै, जबकि चीन म॑ प्रवेश करै वाला नेपाली सामान के सामने ऐसनऽ ही बाधा प॑ कहीं कम जांच होय छै ।

व्यापार विशेषज्ञ के कहनाय छनि जे बुनियादी ढांचा के समस्या नेपाल-चीन के व्यापारिक संबंध मे व्यापक कमजोरी के दर्शाबैत अछि.

व्यापार विशेषज्ञ रबी शंकर सैंजू नँ कहलकै कि दोनों देशौ के बुनियादी व्यापार ढाँचा बदलतौ आर्थिक वास्तविकता के साथ तालमेल नै बनाबै मँ विफल रहलौ छै ।

ओ कहला जे व्यापार आ भुगतान समझौता पुरान भ गेल अछि आ एकर समीक्षा करबाक जरूरत अछि किया कि हम सब एखन एकदम अलग व्यापार युग मे ठाढ़ छी।

2018 के पारगमन समझौता स नेपाल के सैद्धांतिक रूप स चीनी समुद्री बंदरगाह आ शुष्क बंदरगाह तक पहुंच भेटल छल। लेकिन दूनू देश अभी तलक ई व्यवस्था क॑ पूरा तरह स॑ काम करै लेली जरूरी मानक संचालन प्रक्रिया क॑ अंतिम रूप नै देल॑ छै ।

सैंजू के अनुसार हर दू साल पर समझौता के समीक्षा करय के प्रावधान के सेहो बहुत कम सार्थक क्रियान्वयन भेल अछि, सैंजू के अनुसार एहि तंत्र के एक-दू बेर मात्र बैसैत अछि, जे बहुत हद तक समारोहपूर्वक होइत अछि।

title: Nepal stalls UN rapporteur visit amid delays in transitional justice appointments - The Kathmandu Post
description: Nepal stalls UN rapporteur visit amid delays in transitional justice appointments  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
After years of resistance from successive governments, the then KP Sharma Oli government finally agreed in August 2025 to allow Bernard Duhaime—the UN Special Rapporteur on the promotion of truth, justice, reparation and guarantees of non-recurrence—to visit Nepal.

But nearly a year later, the long-awaited visit remains uncertain, with the government yet to respond to Duhaime’s proposal to visit Nepal in November.

The government had initially agreed to a 10-day visit from March 10 to 20, but the dates coincided with Nepal’s general elections. The government and Duhaime subsequently agreed to reschedule the visit for June 9 to 19.

However, after the Balendra Shah government in May first week dismissed the office-bearers of the two transitional justice commissions, along with hundreds of other appointees made by previous governments, it informed Duhaime that the June visit would not be possible.

In its May 18 letter, the government said it would “highly welcome” a rescheduled visit after September. Duhaime responded by proposing his visit for November 17 to 27. Three months later, however, he is still waiting for a response from Kathmandu.

“No formal response from the Nepal government has been received so far,” Duhaime said in an email response to the Post. His visit is intended to assess Nepal’s efforts on truth, justice, reparation, memorialisation and guarantees of non-recurrence in addressing serious human rights violations committed during the 1996–2006 Maoist insurgency.

The Balendra Shah administration cited the vacant leadership of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission and the Commission of Investigation on Enforced Disappeared Persons when it cancelled Duhaime’s June visit. But with the government yet to begin the appointment process for the two transitional justice bodies, it is unclear whether the vacancies can be filled before his proposed visit.

Past appointment processes suggest that filling the vacancies could take around six months, from the call for applications to the final selection. The government itself has no clear answer on when Duhaime will be allowed to visit Nepal.

“We believe his visit would be effective after the appointments in the commissions,” Ramji Danai, chief of the Human Rights Division at the Prime Minister’s Office, told the Post. Danai, however, could not provide a specific timeline for the visit.

The latest uncertainty is part of a longer pattern of Nepal delaying access to UN human rights experts. Along with the special rapporteur on truth, justice and reparation, UN experts and working groups on enforced or involuntary disappearances and extrajudicial, summary or arbitrary executions have repeatedly sought to visit Nepal, with some requests dating back to 2019.

After keeping such requests on hold for years, the government agreed last year to a visit only by Duhaime.

The government’s non-committal position in the special rapporteur’s visit comes as Nepal seeks a third term on the UN Human Rights Council, with elections scheduled for October.

The special rapporteur is a part of the council’s special procedures, through which independent experts are mandated to report and advise on human rights issues.

Human rights experts see a paradox in Nepal seeking a third term on the council while remaining non-committal about a visit by one of the council’s independent human rights experts.

सरकार न॑ १८ मई क॑ लिखलऽ गेलऽ अपनऽ पत्र म॑ कहल॑ छै कि सितंबर के बाद फेर स॑ निर्धारित यात्रा के “अत्यधिक स्वागत” करतै । दुहैमे एकर जवाब मे 17 स 27 नवंबर तक अपन यात्रा क प्रस्ताव देलथि, मुदा तीन मास बाद एखनो काठमांडू स प्रतिक्रिया क इंतजार मे छथि।

बलेन्द्र शाह प्रशासन न॑ दुहैमे केरऽ जून केरऽ दौरा रद्द करतें हुअ॑ सत्य आरू सुलह आयोग आरू जबरन लापता व्यक्ति केरऽ जांच आयोग केरऽ खाली नेतृत्व के हवाला देलकै । लेकिन सरकार केरऽ दू संक्रमणकालीन न्याय निकाय केरऽ नियुक्ति प्रक्रिया अभी शुरू नै होय सकलऽ छै, ई लेली ई साफ नै छै कि हुनकऽ प्रस्तावित यात्रा स॑ पहल॑ खाली पद भरलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै कि नै ।

पिछला नियुक्ति प्रक्रिया स पता चलैत अछि जे रिक्ति कए भरबा मे आवेदन क आह्वान स ल कए अंतिम चयन तक करीब छह मास लागि सकैत अछि। दुहैमे के नेपाल आबय के अनुमति कहिया देल जायत ताहि पर स्वयं सरकार के पास कोनो स्पष्ट जवाब नहि अछि.

एहि तरहक आग्रह कए सालों स रोकला क बाद सरकार पिछला साल केवल दुहैमे क दौरा पर सहमत भ गेल।

विशेष रिपोर्टर केरऽ यात्रा म॑ सरकार केरऽ गैर-प्रतिबद्ध स्थिति ऐन्हऽ समय म॑ आबी रहलऽ छै जब॑ नेपाल संयुक्त राष्ट्र मानवाधिकार परिषद म॑ तेसरऽ कार्यकाल के मांग करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ अक्टूबर म॑ चुनाव होबै वाला छै ।

विशेष रिपोर्टर परिषद केरऽ विशेष प्रक्रिया केरऽ एगो हिस्सा छै, जेकरा माध्यम स॑ स्वतंत्र विशेषज्ञऽ क॑ मानव अधिकारऽ के मुद्दा प॑ रिपोर्ट करै आरू सलाह दै के जिम्मा देलऽ जाय छै ।

मानवाधिकार विशेषज्ञ सब के विरोधाभास देखै छै कि नेपाल म॑ परिषद म॑ तेसरऽ कार्यकाल के मांग करलऽ जाय छै जबकि परिषद केरऽ एगो स्वतंत्र मानवाधिकार विशेषज्ञ केरऽ दौरा के बारे म॑ प्रतिबद्ध नै छै ।

full_article:

DHAKA, Aug 22, 2026 (BSS) - Bangladesh High Performance (HP) team made a flying start to their Top End T20 campaign, whacking Nepal past by 9 wickets at Marrara Stadium in Darwin today.

Off-spinner Mohammad Rubel starred with the ball, taking 4-18 as Bangladesh restricted Nepal A to 99-9 in 20 overs.

Bangladesh HP gunned down the target in just 10.2 overs to seal a comprehensive victory with Jisan Alam hitting an unbeaten half-century.

Bangladesh captain Irfan Shukkur won the toss and opted to field, a decision that paid off immediately as Nepal lost five wickets for just 13 runs.

Kushal Bhurtel offered some resistance, scoring 46, while Sahab Alam made 11 and Bipin Khatri remained unbeaten on 11.

The rest of Nepal's batters failed to reach double figures.

Rubel was the pick of the Bangladesh bowlers, claiming four wickets in his four-over spell.

Samiun Basir, Ripon Mondol and Rohanat Doula took one wicket each.

Chasing 100, Bangladesh raced to 32 without loss after two overs. Habibur Rahman Sohan was dismissed in the third over, but his departure did little to slow the chase.

Jisan Alam then took charge, launching an aggressive assault alongside Ariful Islam.

He brought up his half-century from just 29 balls as Bangladesh reached the target in only 10.2 overs.

Jisan remained unbeaten on 52, while Ariful contributed an unbeaten 34 off 27 balls.

The victory marked Bangladesh HP's third appearance in the Top End T20 tournament in Australia. Bangladesh reached the final in one of their previous two campaigns but failed to win the title.

Bangladesh HP will face Hobart Hurricanes Academy in their next match at Marrara Stadium on Sunday.

ऑफ स्पिनर मोहम्मद रूबेल गेंद के साथ अभिनय करलकै, जेकरा म॑ बंगलादेश न॑ २० ओवर म॑ नेपाल ए क॑ ९९-९ प॑ सीमित करी देलकै ।

बंगलादेश एचपी न॑ महज १०.२ ओवर म॑ गोल करी क॑ जिसान आलम न॑ नाबाद आधा शतक के साथ व्यापक जीत प॑ मुहर लगाय देलकै ।

बांग्लादेश केरऽ कप्तान इरफान शुक्कुर न॑ टॉस जीती क॑ मैदान प॑ उतरै के विकल्प चुनलकै, जेकरऽ फैसला तुरंत फलित होय गेलै, कैन्हेंकि नेपाल न॑ महज १३ रन प॑ ५ विकेट गंवाय देलकै ।

कुशल भूर्टेल न॑ कुछ प्रतिरोध करतें हुअ॑ ४६ रन बनैलकै, जबकि साहब आलम न॑ ११ आरू बिपिन खत्री ११ रन प॑ नाबाद रहलै ।

नेपाल के बाकी बल्लेबाज दोगुना आंकड़ा तक पहुंचय मे असफल रहल।

रूबेल बांग्लादेश केरऽ गेंदबाजऽ के पिक छेलै, जेकरा म॑ हुनी अपनऽ चार ओवर के स्पेल म॑ चार विकेट प॑ दावा करलकै ।

समिउन बसीर, रिपोन मोंडोल आ रोहनत डौला एक-एक विकेट लेलक।

100 रन के पीछा करैत बांग्लादेश दू ओवर के बाद बिना हार के 32 रन तक पहुंच गेल। हबीबुर रहमान सोहन क॑ तेसरऽ ओवर म॑ आउट करी देलऽ गेलै, लेकिन ओकरऽ जाय स॑ पीछा धीमा करै म॑ कोय काम नै करलकै ।

एकरऽ बाद जीसान आलम न॑ अरिफुल इस्लाम के साथ-साथ आक्रामक हमला करी क॑ प्रभार संभाललकै ।

ओ मात्र २९ गेंद सँ अपन आधा शतक बनौलनि, जखन कि बंगलादेश मात्र १०.२ ओवर मे लक्ष्य पर पहुँचि गेल छल ।

जिसान ५२ रन पर नाबाद रहलै, जबकि अरिफुल न॑ २७ गेंद प॑ नाबाद ३४ रन के योगदान देलकै ।

ई जीत स॑ बांग्लादेश एचपी न॑ ऑस्ट्रेलिया म॑ आयोजित टॉप एंड टी-२० टूर्नामेंट म॑ तीसरा बार शामिल होय गेलऽ छै । बांग्लादेश अपनऽ पिछला दू अभियानऽ म॑ स॑ एगो अभियान म॑ फाइनल म॑ पहुँची गेलऽ छेलै लेकिन खिताब नै जीत॑ सकलऽ छेलै ।

रविदिन मरारा स्टेडियम मे बंगलादेश एचपी के अगिला मैच मे होबार्ट हरिकेन्स एकेडमी के सामना होयत।

Ariful Islam at one down remained unbeaten on 34 off 27 balls as they raced to 101-1 in just 10.2 overs to complete a comprehensive victory.

Bangladesh High Performance XI will next face Hobart Hurricanes Academy at the same venue on Sunday.

title: Government and 'Nation, Nationality, Religion, Culture and Citizen Protection Great Campaign, Nepal' Reach 14-Point Agreement - Ratopati
description: Government and 'Nation, Nationality, Religion, Culture and Citizen Protection Great Campaign, Nepal' Reach 14-Point Agreement  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. A 14-point agreement has been reached between the government led by Prime Minister Balendra Shah and 'Nation, Nationality, Religion, Culture and Citizen Protection Great Campaign, Nepal'.

With the agreement, the Great Campaign has decided to end all its धरना and protest programs from today itself.

The agreement paper was signed after intensive discussions between the representatives of the Great Campaign, who were staging a धरना at Pulchowk, Lalitpur, and the government-formed negotiation team. Prime Minister's Press Advisor Deepa Dahal made this agreement public through the social media Facebook.

On behalf of the government, Lilaadhar Subedi, coordinator of the negotiation team and joint secretary of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers' office, and on behalf of the Great Campaign, Vishnu Bohora Kshetri, coordinator of the negotiation committee, signed the agreement paper.

It has been stated that the citizens' demands will now be addressed through government processes after the uncomfortable situation created by the movement centered in the Kathmandu Valley was resolved through talks and agreement. Following the agreement, the धरना that was being held in the Pulchowk area has also been removed from today.

काठमांडू। प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाहके नेतृत्वमे सरकार आ ‘राष्ट्र, राष्ट्रियता, धर्म, संस्कृति आ नागरिक संरक्षण महाअभियान, नेपाल’के बीच १४ बुँदे सहमति भेल अछि ।

ललितपुर केरऽ पुलचौक म॑ धरना आयोजित करी रहलऽ महान अभियान केरऽ प्रतिनिधि आरू सरकार द्वारा गठित वार्ता टीम के बीच गहन चर्चा के बाद समझौता पत्र प॑ हस्ताक्षर करलऽ गेलै । प्रधानमंत्री के प्रेस सलाहकार दीपा दाहाल सोशल मीडिया फेसबुक के माध्यम सं एहि समझौता के सार्वजनिक केलनि.

सरकार के तरफ स॑ वार्ता टीम के संयोजक आरू प्रधानमंत्री आरू मंत्री परिषद के कार्यालय के संयुक्त सचिव लीलाधर सुबेदी आरू महान अभियान के तरफ स॑ वार्ता समिति के संयोजक विष्णु बोहोरा क्षेत्री न॑ समझौता पत्र प॑ हस्ताक्षर करलकै ।

काठमांडू उपत्यका मे केन्द्रित आन्दोलन सँ उत्पन्न असहज स्थिति वार्ता आ सहमति के माध्यम सँ समाधान भेलाक बाद आब सरकारी प्रक्रिया के माध्यम सँ नागरिक के मांग के समाधान कयल जायत से कहल गेल अछि । समझौता के बाद पुलचौक क्षेत्र में जे नाना आयोजित करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छेलै, ओकरा भी आय स॑ हटाय देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

title: Protests Erupt In Nepal Over Suspected Rape, Murder Of Three-year-old Girl - ETV Bharat
description: Protests Erupt In Nepal Over Suspected Rape, Murder Of Three-year-old Girl  ETV Bharat
publisher.title: ETV Bharat
full_article:
Kathmandu: The suspected rape and murder of a three-year-old girl in Nepal has triggered protests with locals obstructing the Birgunj-Pathlaiya road section of Simara for the fourth consecutive day on Saturday.

The girl, a resident of Bhaktinagar in Jeetpur sub-metropolitan city of Bara district of Madhesh province, was found dead near her house on August 18, three days after she went missing.

Locals staged a sit-in on the Birgunj-Pathlaiya section of Simara by installing a tent demanding justice for the girl, the police said. The police suspect that the girl was murdered after being raped. The police have arrested two suspects in the case so far.

A 16-year-old local youth, who had also been helping with the search for the missing girl, was arrested with the help of sniffer dogs deployed to search the area, Kathmandu Post newspaper reported.
